name: Artistry Portfolio
description: Full-page minimalist artist portfolio with fixed header and scroll progress line, word-reveal headline, parallax hero image, lightbox gallery, exhibitions list and footer.
contents: Fixed header with brand, tagline, scroll progress line, nav links and contact button
Hero with animated headline, parallax grayscale image, caption and about text
Gallery grid with captions and fullscreen lightbox, plus quote
Footer with email, socials, studio lines, copyright and back to top link
behavior: Headline words slide up and hero image wipes open on load
Gallery, quote and exhibition rows fade up when scrolled into view
Hero image shifts with page scroll and the header line shows scroll progress
Nav underline follows the section in view, links scroll smoothly to sections by id
Lightbox supports arrow keys, Escape and locks body scroll while open
Images turn from grayscale to color on hover

props.name: aboutText
props.default: I am a visual artist exploring the intersection of mental landscapes and corporal reality. Through stark structures and negative space, my canvas strips away chaos to present what remains.

props.name: quote
props.default: "When the mind becomes a labyrinth of anxious thoughts, art offers a thin structural thread back to reality."

editableByProps: All text, links, images, captions, exhibitions and socials
Page, text and footer background colors
Navigation items and their section ids

needsCodeEdit.change: Change header background and bar colors

needsCodeEdit.where: EASE constant and transitionDelay in the h1

fixed: Header is fixed to the top of the viewport and uses blend mode difference
Film grain overlay is fixed over the whole viewport
Scroll progress and parallax read window scroll
Nav links scroll to elements by id, so the first three navItems ids map to hero, gallery and exhibitions sections
Locks body overflow while the lightbox is open and restores it on close
Gray scale image styling and monospace and serif font classes come from the host fonts
